mermaid.min.js is the browser (IIFE) build of Mermaid 11.12.2, MIT license
(mermaid.LICENSE beside it), fetched once from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.2/dist/mermaid.min.js
and shipped as a pinned asset: documents render offline, with no CDN.

nunito-latin.woff2 and nunito-latin-ext.woff2 are the variable-weight Nunito
font (SIL Open Font License 1.1, nunito.LICENSE beside them), fetched once from
@fontsource-variable/nunito@5.3.0 on jsdelivr. Markdown documents are set in it.
